[Podcast #531: How to Best Harness Your Willpower](https://www.artofmanliness.com/podcast/podcast-531-how-to-best-harness-your-willpower/),
The Art of Manliness, 5 August 2019.
[Notes](https://docs.google.com/document/d/10TPSkKjjjc8L3XmV6pJWrgYinIFSpxGzZxRT2Yj_VSI/edit)
in Google Docs.

Kelly McGonigal, a psychologist at Stanford, talks with Brett McKay about her
book *The Willpower Instinct*.

**Sleep, exercise and meditation do the most to support willpower.** McGonigal
calls better sleep "probably the number one" change, since sleep deprivation
"basically derails all of the neurological processes that make it easier to
have willpower". A few minutes of exercise or of meditation a day also helps.
All three raise awareness as much as they raise willpower.

The [O'Gieblyn episode on EconTalk](addiction-faith-and-the-limits-of-willpower.qmd)
takes the other side, with Simone Weil's line that faults are cured by
attention rather than by will.
